Episode 249. The First Deployment of the Plutonian (13)

Among the deployed Plutonian, Vahn and three Battle Kings were the first to return to Tikan. The rest of the Plutonian were to return after sweeping the remaining temples along with the Sun God Religion priests.
Tikan's comrades couldn't help but be stunned for a while after hearing about their exploits.

“…So, you mean to say that as soon as Lord Vahn and the Plutonian entered the Black Sea, they annihilated Nirgand, met Lord Chiron for a chat, and then attacked the Sun God Religion's subspace, ending them all. And in the midst of that, they encountered someone claiming to be the Sun God… And you're saying that this Bligiet was using the body of Lord Temar Runcandel!?”
Vahn nodded lightly at Jet's words. She had been explaining all these events in a nonchalant voice as if they were nothing significant.
Even Jin blinked in disbelief. He knew Vahn's prowess better than anyone, but he didn't expect her to solve so many issues and return.
“Ahem! Then, may I ask what the toughest battle was among those?”
Jet mustered up his courage.

The strongest, recognized by everyone, and the legendary Battle God, Vahn. Who was stronger between the two had recently become a topic of discussion among the alliance members. It was a topic of curiosity not only for the alliance members but for most people in the world.
“The toughest was fighting Jin's father, Chiron. I even lost to him.”
“What... Then...!”
Vahn's eyes suddenly turned cold. Of course, Jet dared not say out loud that this meant Lord Chiron was the strongest.
Instead, Luna spoke up.
“No, no! Lord Vahn. I heard that father used both hands, while Lord Vahn only used one…? Ah, my head. It's confusing. Was it even possible to fight my father with one hand?”
“It wasn’t a real battle, just a simple contest of strength.”

“So what you’re saying is, brother Battle God, your loss was just a simple contest of strength, and even then, you only used one hand. It’s not a true defeat. Haha... Ha, ha. Oh my, my head. I should check the chaos particle measurement, yes! Ahem!”
Boras, who had been interpreting Vahn's words, received glares and quickly left the scene.

“…So it's even harder to accept. Lord Vahn hadn’t fully recovered from her injuries, passed on the Battle God blood to the youngest, and she said her prime was over, right? But how could she fight my father with one hand?”
“Is it unbelievable, Luna?”
“No, it's not that, but…”
“What you mean is true, and it's a huge shock that the head of the Runcandel felt defeated in some way. And you probably want to say that, like Lord Vahn, father wasn’t in his best condition either.”
This time, Mary explained Luna's words. Luntia and Tona, standing nearby, nodded in agreement, but they too received Luna’s cold glare and pretended to be elsewhere.
“Luna. It doesn’t matter who is stronger between me and Chiron. We are on the same side.”
“That's true…”
“Even if we were enemies, it would be the same. If Chiron and I fought, whoever won would either die or be critically injured and unable to recover. Or be incapacitated.”
“Even if you were in your prime!?”
“Even in my prime. But Boras, didn’t you just leave to check the chaos particles?”
“Ah, the particle levels have returned to normal. Please don’t hit me…”
“What? It's like I regularly hit you. Don't give people the wrong idea.”
“Wouldn’t I die if hit even once by the Battle God Brother?”
Soon, Vahn burst into laughter, and Luna felt a strange emotion. The other siblings also felt oddly.

“Anyway, the meeting with Chiron was very impressive to me. Unlike me or Temar, he does not rely on Jin and fulfills his destiny. You can look forward to it. And the arrangements in the Black Sea by Solderet, he will be able to find out.”
Chiron did not convey any separate message to Inse. However, Vahn shared the conversations she had with Chiron for a while, especially those about clan, children, and family.

"He seemed not to worry differently about Jin and the rest of you. And he seemed very eager to meet Ballas. Tell Ballas this when I am not around. Chiron really wanted to see him, ask for specifics, it's obvious that he will intensely nag me."
The light mood ended there. Although only a day had passed since all these events occurred, the newly revealed information and enemies were immensely heavy.
“Bligiet…”
Ameris began to speak, pressing her throbbing head.
As soon as Vahn mentioned that name, Ameris felt a headache and began to recall blurry old memories. In some ways, it was natural, as the Sun God was not called by a single name.
"Do you remember something, Lady Ameris?"
"Kinzelo, that name represents the most complete state of the Sun God. He had many names. Just like each of my nine heads was called by a different name..."
Bligiet.
The name Ameris remembered was one of the selves that had split from the 'complete Sun God'.

"Essentially, Bligiet is no different from beings like Bale or Hedo. If we were to break it down into components, you could say they are the same. However, Bligiet is of a higher rank and formed with a more distinct will."
Bale, who was nearby, seemed somewhat displeased by this comparison.

"Imagine there is a large rock called the Sun God, and when this rock breaks, many fragments like Bale and Lord Hedo remain. Among them, a particularly large piece, not just a fragment but one that can be called a rock in itself. Bligiet is such an existence."
"…So, you mean to say there are more beings like Bligiet."

"Yes, there are certainly more. But I can't remember exactly how many. It was more than five, I think... They will only be remembered when they become distinctly aware of their name and existence, like Bligiet."
The eyes of Jin and his colleagues hardened. Ameris's words meant that beings like Bligiet could wake up at any time.
Even Vahn showed a sign of concern.

"If there are several like Bligiet, that's definitely dangerous. Not something to be compared with Nirgand or Luke. I couldn't even be sure if I could definitely kill him. In fact, Brother Jin might be more specialized in dealing with such beings than I am."
"Why do you think so, Battle God Brother?"

"Because Brother has an element that neither I nor Chiron possess. It's hard to explain in detail... But don't you feel it, Brother? The power of existence, or something similar. And that power Brother possesses is certainly superior to Temar's."
If Temar had been in the same situation as Brother, he would have collapsed the moment he faced Rosa. Vahn swallowed the rest of her words.

"But just because Brother Jin is more specialized, it doesn't mean he can easily capture them. From my fight, Bligiet definitely had the caliber to be called a god of gods. Among the alliance members, only I, Chiron, Brother Jin, and Luna would be able to properly fight him."
"If several such beings were to appear at once..."
Luntia squinted her eyes as she spoke. With Bligiet resurrected out of nowhere, it seemed like anything could happen.
"Everyone, not all selves of the Sun God are necessarily our enemies. Right, Lady Ameris?"
At Jin's words, Ameris nodded.

"The tendencies of the Sun God's selves can be divided into three: maintaining the world, destroying the world, and reconstructing the world. These three types of selves are hostile to each other. However, destruction and reconstruction can sometimes cooperate. They share some common goals, so they use each other."
Bligiet was a self with the will of 'reconstruction'. It was also what the Sun God Religion, including Luke, had longed for.
Naturally, only the selves with the will of 'world maintenance' could be allies of the alliance.
"Vahn, when Bligeit mentioned freeing the physical restraints, you said you had an intuition that he would go to Zipfel, right?"
"Yes, Ameris."

"I think after fighting you, he might have added to his plans. Not just Zipfel, but he might awaken the will of another Sun God to confront you. He is the self of the Sun God himself. He would already know where the other selves are, and how they are dormant."
"Brother Jin will have a hard time."
"You speak as if it's someone else's business, Battle God Brother."

"I'm serious. Though I would fight by Brother's side no matter how many of them come, fundamentally, it seems like ending their threat will be Brother Jin's role. I'm curious how much difference in combat power each self will have. Based on Bligiet, even I couldn't face more than two at once."
Jin felt something boiling inside him.
It was anger.

'We'll have to see, but Kinzelo has practically declared surrender and the alliance… has annihilated the Demon Realm, the Red Plutonian, and the Sun God Religion. And now it's the selves of the Sun God.'
It wasn't an entirely unforeseen element.
The only visible enemy remaining was Zipfel, but the intervention of transcendent beings like Witch Heluram, the Sun God, or Solderet was somewhat anticipated.
Jin suppressed his anger and looked around at his colleagues.
"Still, now it's just the selves of the Sun God and Zipfel. We're nearing the end. Let's first figure out Bligiet's movements and prepare a countermeasure. We need to retrieve Temar's body from him."
